BREAKING: The NHL's San Jose Sharks will begin accepting cryptocurrency as a payment option starting next season.

Fans can purchase season tickets, merchandise, and more, using Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Dogecoin.

(h/t @sbjsbd)

Robinhood brought in $233 million in crypto revenue in Q2—more than options & equities combined—but 61% of that came from Dogecoin.

Robinhood has now seen its crypto revenue drop 78% in Q3, and the stock is down 50% from its high.
